evidence: Carries the Validation label and updates core chainstate operations in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Retires an architectural hazard where non-validating routines like FlushStateToDisk and DisconnectTip used BlockValidationState out-parameters for runtime disk errors. Decoupling fatal system errors from consensus and policy checks strengthens chainstate error invariants and unblocks #35570.
